items.title: GPT-4
items.summary: We’ve created GPT-4, the latest milestone in OpenAI’s effort in scaling up deep learning. GPT-4 is a large multimodal model (accepting image and text inputs, emitting text outputs) that, while less capable than humans in many real-world scenarios, exhibits human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了GPT-4，这是其在扩大深度学习规模方面的最新里程碑。GPT-4是一个大型多模态模型，能够接受图像和文本输入并生成文本输出。虽然在许多现实场景中仍不如人类全面，但它在各种专业和学术基准测试中表现出人类水平的性能，极大地推动了行业边界。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI正式发布了具有里程碑意义的多模态大模型GPT-4，在多个专业和学术基准上展现出人类同等水平的性能。

items.title: Powering virtual education for the classroom
items.summary: Khan Academy explores the potential for GPT-4 in a limited pilot program.

items.title: Preserving languages for the future
items.summary: How Iceland is using GPT-4 to preserve its language.
items.summaryZh: 冰岛正在通过集成GPT-4等大语言模型技术来保护和延续其本国语言。这一实践展示了先进AI模型在非英语语种保护、数字化转型的实际应用价值，为全球小语种在人工智能时代的生存与发展提供了值得借鉴的成功案例。
